domain.text: TypeScript worker CLI and gateway verbs for task setup, PR operations, push, review polling, and Markdown checks.

impressions.text: The work added worker verbs and server-side safeguards, including restricting pushes to the worker’s own open task PR and filtering review wake-ups by orchestrator identity.
The orchestrator praised the push policy, review identity checks, PR-comment checks, and package-replacement test; it also verified the full local check and CI.
Round 1 review caught that repository root resolution relied on the current directory; the worker fixed it to use VMETHOD_ROOT or git discovery and added nested-directory tests.

The orchestrator noted a known limitation: the in-process gateway reads people.yaml from the agent’s checkout, so editing that file or setting VMETHOD_ROOT can change whom it trusts; a separate MCP server was proposed as the fix.
The owner-directed switch from bash to TypeScript superseded the legacy snapshot requirement, and the orchestrator accepted that deviation.
